recent.title: KC1036 in ewing sarcoma: mechanistic insights and future directions for a multi-targeted therapeutic strategy.
KC1036, a multi-kinase inhibitor with anti-angiogenic activity, can effectively suppress the tumor growth of Ewing sarcoma.
